name: Clip-On Open-Ear Earbuds — LED Display
description: Open-ear earbuds that clip onto the ear instead of sitting inside it. The round charging case has an LED display that shows the battery level, and charges over USB-C. Bluetooth 5.4 with touch controls; they connect when you open the lid and work with iPhone and Android.

source.notes: Seller style Q71 (skin = Champagne, black = Black with a silver case, purple). ¥15.90 ≈ ₦3,554.77 per piece (screenshot a7c5a2f6); listing shows a coupon price (¥8.90) not used. Specs from the supplier images: LED battery display, non-in-ear, open-lid connect, touch, Bluetooth 5.4, Type-C, Apple/Android compatible. Generic, unbranded. Listing title: Huaqiangbei 10th-generation clip-on open-ear earphones. Lithium battery: sea freight only. China domestic shipping from ¥3 (≈₦670.71) per order, not per item. Left out of the copy on purpose: listing hero shows an AirPods logo (never used), "flagship certified", Hi-Res/IMAX/"Bluetooth 8.0" claims, the rename feature, IPX5 and 1-year warranty (unconfirmed).
